activity.notes: Tomás de Torquemada was appointed Inquisitor General of Castile and León in August 1483 and his jurisdiction was extended to Aragon, Catalonia and Valencia in October. He remained the leading organizer of the Spanish Inquisition until his death in 1498. ATLAS uses the higher-order composite Spanish Monarchy as the map-level polity and records formal service, not sovereign rule.

sources.title: Tomás de Torquemada — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani gives Torquemada's appointment as Inquisitor General in 1483, extension of his jurisdiction across the major Spanish crowns, and death in 1498.
